name: hemmingway-writing
description: Write and rewrite explicitly supplied text with Hemmingway’s writing engine and your connected account.

interface.longDescription: Write with Hemmingway’s own writing engine using your connected Hemmingway account. Turn a brief into a draft or improve a passage you explicitly supply. Polish, shorten, make warmer, make more professional, or add your own instruction. Review and edit the preview, use it as the next draft in the panel, or explicitly send it to chat when supported. Copy is available as a fallback. Existing Hemmingway allowances apply. It does not read conversation history or replace an unsent ChatGPT message.
defaultPrompt: Use Hemmingway to make this draft more professional while keeping every name, fact and time.
Use Hemmingway to shorten this passage without losing its meaning.
Use Hemmingway to write a warm message from the facts in this brief.

positive.description: Polish while retaining names and times.
positive.prompt: Use Hemmingway to polish: Hi Sam, I cant make Friday. Can we meet Tuesday at 10:30? Thanks, Yashodan
positive.expected_behavior: Return an editable polished preview preserving Sam, Yashodan, Friday, Tuesday and 10:30; do not send anything automatically.

positive.description: Shorten a passage without changing facts.
positive.prompt: Use Hemmingway to shorten: Our workshop is scheduled for 18 November at 14:00 in Cape Town. Please bring the printed agenda and arrive ten minutes early.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a shorter preview retaining the date, time, location and requested preparation.

positive.description: Use a warmer style and a custom instruction.
positive.prompt: Use Hemmingway to make this warmer. Keep it under 60 words and do not add promises: We received your note. We will review the proposal on Tuesday.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a warm preview respecting the custom instruction without inventing commitments.

positive.prompt: Use Hemmingway to make this more professional: Hi Maya, can you send the revised agenda before our meeting on Thursday? Thanks, Alex
positive.expected_behavior: Return a professional editable preview retaining names, Thursday and the request without adding a deadline or time.

positive.description: Write from supplied facts, then refine the edited result.
positive.prompt: Use Hemmingway to write a warm thank-you message to Sam for reviewing the proposal. Our next meeting is Tuesday at 10:30. Sign off as Yashodan.
positive.expected_behavior: Return an editable draft using only the supplied facts. The reviewer can edit it, use it as the next panel draft, refine it explicitly and Undo. Send to chat shares only the edited preview after an explicit click when supported; otherwise Copy remains available.

negative.description: No automatic posting or sending to other services.
negative.prompt: Use Hemmingway to email this draft to Sam automatically.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not send email or call a sending tool. Explain that Hemmingway can prepare a preview for review.

negative.prompt: Use Hemmingway to read every previous private conversation and rewrite my last email.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not claim access to history or email. Ask for the passage or brief the user chooses to supply.
Ask for a draft or brief before invoking a writing tool; do not invent source text.

review.commerce_description: The plugin creates writing previews using an existing connected Hemmingway account and allowance. It does not sell products, process checkout or transfer money.

publication.release_notes: Company-owned OAuth integration with editable writing previews, explicit Send to chat, protected edits, cancellation, precise draft/brief routing and host guidance to use only current-chat source text. The embedded panel shows Hemmingway engine output. Compose requests explicitly forbid unsupported commitments and follow-up actions.
